text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] kv-service prefix-cache eviction spike -> paging started. rate=12k/s, key-space growth 18x in 3m. grafana: https://grafana.company/board/kv-cache?from=now-15m
megan_sre: i'm paged, oncall acked :white_check_mark:
megan_sre: first look: continuous-batcher started accepting much larger sequences after yesterday's config roll; batching window increased, prefix hashing misaligned w/ tokenizer v2 rollout -> massive cache churn
omar_infra: yep, seeing huge write amplification to kv-store, iops ~5x and network egress climbs. listing top prefixes now
ben_h: any prod errors or customer reports?
priya_ml: traces show heavy recomputation of prompt templates for the same user ids — template rendering produced slightly different whitespace -> different prompt hashes
alice.chen: customers: 14 orgs reporting intermittent 5xx and timeouts, mostly chat/stream endpoints. SLO latency p50 220ms -> 1.2s, p95 -> 4.8s
megan_sre: mitigation plan - immediate steps: 1) throttle batching (env toggle), 2) set eviction TTLs higher to stop churn, 3) rollback tokenizer mapping, 4) reduce routing to canary region. executing now
megan_sre: running command to disable continuous batching on dedicated pools:
```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/continuous-batcher CONTINUOUS_BATCHING_ENABLED=false
kubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/continuous-batcher
```
omar_infra: doing TTL bump on kv-store (redis shim):
```
redis-cli -h kv-store-prod EVAL "return redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYRANK', KEYS[1], 0, -10000)" 1 prefix_index
# temporarily bump default TTL to 48h
redis-cli -h kv-store-prod CONFIG SET hz 10
```
priya_ml: patching prompt-hashing to normalize whitespace asap. small hotfix ready, can hotpatch if needed.
ben_h: deploy hotfix to tokenization mapping? what's risk?
priya_ml: low risk, just canonicalize templates and reconcilers. I'll push to canary then prod
megan_sre: temporarily routed 20% traffic to fallback-model to reduce write pressure. routing command:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/routes/modify -d '{"route":"chat.v1","fallback_pct":20}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
ml-runtime-bot: [metric] kv.prefix_keys_total increased from 2.1M -> 37.8M in 4m
pagerduty: oncall megan_sre acknowledged incident (INC-2026-5432)
alice.chen: alerted cs + account leads for impacted customers, noting degraded latency and occasional 500s. prepping incident comms draft.
omar_infra: eviction rate dropped ~70% after disabling batching, iops trending down. still seeing prefix-key additions from edge templates
priya_ml: pushed canonicalizer patch to canary; will monitor. snippet:
```
# normalize templates
def normalize_prompt(t):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t).strip()
```
megan_sre: canary looks good for 5m, no spike. preparing full rollout in 10m
ben_h: extracted sample diff between tokenizer v1/v2 behaviour; tokenizer v2 introduced a non-deterministic token split for tabs -> different promptkey on rendered templates. file: s3://redwood-ops/artifacts/tokenizer-v2-diff.log
alice.chen: comms: sending initial note to impacted customers: short apology, explain mitigation, ETA for full fix 2-3h. will follow up with postmortem.
megan_sre: next steps: 1) promote patch after canary, 2) add alert for prefix key growth (rate > 2k/s sustained 1m), 3) add unit test in rollout pipeline to check tokenizer determinism, 4) postmortem + RCA. assigning owners: priya_ml -> tokenizer fix, omar_infra -> kv throttles + eviction automation, ben_h -> postmortem writeup, megan_sre -> incident lead
priya_ml: promoted patch to prod at 2276543500, monitoring
ml-runtime-bot: [metric] prefix_keys_total stabilized ~3.2M after 15m
megan_sre: rolling restart of kv-proxy on prod to clear transient state: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy`
omar_infra: manual reclaim run completed, reclaimed ~22GB, paging reduced
alice.chen: update sent to customers: link to status page and follow-up promised after RCA
ben_h: logging next epics: add tokenizer-canary-gate in CI, prefix-key alerting, and batching config guardrails. also consider incremental rollout for template changes
megan_sre: handing off to omar_infra for overnight watch. oncall shift change in 2h — pinged next oncall.
omar_infra: ack, will watch for 6h window, set temporary runbook in incidents channel.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, customer impact reduced. incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. next: postmortem in 48h.
megan_sre: thanks all. quick notes for postmortem: root cause = tokenizer v2 non-deterministic splits + batching window change exposed template whitespace diffs -> high prefix-cardinality -> kv churn -> paging. Contributing: rollout lacked deterministic tests and batching guardrails.
priya_ml: will include a diff of tokenizer tokenization for the PM.
ben_h: i'll start postmortem draft, linking logs and timeline. tagging eng-ml + eng-runtime for follow-ups. :memo:
alice.chen: closing ticket for customer comms, will share draft in #customer-success for review
megan_sre: incident resolved -> monitoring. Thanks team. :tada:
